entities.text: Najmul Hoque @ Najimul Hoque @ Najmul Hoque
entities.label: PETITIONER

sentences.text:
The present revision of the year 2020 is for quashing of the proceedings in G.R. Case No. 1987 of 2018 arising out of Chanchal P.S. Case No. 671 of 2018 under Sections 498A/323/325/313/34 of the Indian Penal Code read with Sections 3/4 of the D.P.
Act., pending before the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Chanchal.
Mr. Angshuman Chakraboarty learned counsel is appointed to represent the State.
As none appears for the petitioners in spite of repeated calls since the date of listing, the revisional application stands dismissed for default.
All connected application, if any, stands disposed of.
Interim order, if any, stands vacated.
Let a copy of the order be sent to the learned trial court for compliance and to proceed with the trial in accordance with law.
Learned counsel for the State to inform the status of this case to the concerned authority.
